'''Aine 14 (March 29)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - The ship carrying [[Mattin Stepaneos den Balgar]] arrives in [[Tar Valon]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Renna]] stabs [[Egeanin]] and is shot dead while trying to flee from [[Mat]]'s party.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Kairen Stang]] is reported dead, murdered using ''[[saidin]]''.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Egwene]] commences the mission to turn [[Tar Valon]]'s harbor chains into [[Cuendillar]], but is taken captive halfway through and made a prisoner of the [[White Tower]].
